answer: Trust propagates through bounded random walks on an attestation graph, so each voter’s influence is limited by reachable, verified trust rather than self-created identities. If a sybil set S has low conductance, φ(S)=cut(S,V\S)/vol(S), few walks from honest seeds cross its sparse boundary; with capped walk contributions, this bounds its aggregate voting weight by the incoming trust flow, even if relic, opal, and nebula are densely linked within S.
